Metadata.title: Celoria - AI Agents for Salon Chains
Metadata.description: Automate the data work. Focus on what matters. The AI layer that monitors your stores, detects anomalies, and delivers insights to the owner.

Hero.description: Automate the data work. Focus on what matters.

Problem.title: As salon chains grow, data review becomes a bottleneck.
Problem.card1Title: Smaller chains: Owner does it herself
Problem.card1Item1: Pulls reports from each store manually
Problem.card1Item2: Tries to spot issues across 10, 20, 50 locations
Problem.card1Item3: Spends hours on data instead of running the business
Problem.card1Conclusion: No time left for what matters: coaching staff, improving service, growing the brand
Problem.card2Item1: GM pulls weekly reports, compares stores in Excel
Problem.card2Item2: Can tell you what happened, but not why
Problem.card2Item3: Doesn't understand the business deeply enough for real fixes
Problem.card2Conclusion: $120K/yr for shallow analysis. Owner still has to figure it out herself.
Problem.callout: Either way, the same problem: The person who understands the business can't read the data fast enough. The person who reads the data doesn't understand the business. In beauty, where service is 90%+ of the value, this gap directly impacts revenue.

Insight.quote: Our hypothesis from working with QQ Nails: the middle layer — the GM who sits between data and decisions — doesn't need to be a person. An AI agent can monitor 50 stores in real time, detect anomalies, and deliver actionable insights directly to the owner — the person who actually knows what to do with them.
Insight.supportingText: The owner saves $120K in GM salary. Gets higher-frequency data, deeper attribution, and real-time alerts — through announcements, direct messages, and performance dashboards. No middleman. No weekly lag. No shallow analysis.

Solution.title: A full-stack system with infrastructure designed for AI.
Solution.subtitle: The operations platform is live in 35 stores. The AI layer is what we're building next — and it only works because we built the right foundation first.
Solution.proven4Desc: KPIs in employee reviews, not separate tools
Solution.provenCallout: Built by operators. Per-store config, group appointments, tip presets — details only an 18-year veteran would know to build.
Solution.nextCallout: Our infrastructure was designed for AI from day one — data models, APIs, and multi-device sync all built to support AI agents acting autonomously.

WhyNow.title: The window opened in 2025.
WhyNow.card1Desc: For the first time, domain-specific AI agents can reason about complex business operations — reconciliation, scheduling optimization, demand prediction — at a cost that works for SMBs. This wasn't possible 2 years ago.
WhyNow.card2Desc: We started from a blank page in 2024. No existing customers to break, no old architecture to maintain. We can ship AI features faster because every design decision was made with AI in mind.
WhyNow.calloutText: The cost of AI inference dropped 10x in 18 months. The next 2–3 years will determine who owns the operational data layer for service businesses. After that, switching costs lock the market.

AIVision.title: Automate the low-value work. Free managers for what matters.
AIVision.subtitle: Based on QQ Nails research (50 stores). Our hypothesis: AI can handle the data processing that consumes managers' time, so they can focus on coaching teams, improving service, and growing the brand.
AIVision.focus1Desc: With data-backed insights, not gut feeling
AIVision.focus2Desc: AI executes; humans create the ideas
AIVision.focus4Desc: The 90% of beauty that only humans can do

Traction.title: Live in production. Real stores. Real data.
Traction.callout: Solo-built. Zero outside funding. 2 months from first deploy to 35 locations. These stores validate the core operations platform — scheduling, payments, staff management. The AI layer is our next phase.
Traction.quote: 18 years in the industry, 50 stores. Our previous platform couldn't solve our real problems — staff couldn't use it, managers spent hours on reconciliation, and marketing was all manual. We needed a system built for how we actually work.
Traction.quoteAttribution: — Joey Fei, Co-founder / COO, former QQ Nails owner

BusinessModel.title: Three revenue layers that compound with each location.
BusinessModel.tier1Desc: $199/location/month — less than half of incumbent pricing
BusinessModel.tier2Desc: 2.6% + $0.10 per transaction — strategic processor partnership enables lowest rates
BusinessModel.footnote: Based on ~370 transactions/location/month at $50 avg. ticket. With AI Premium: $453/mo at ~87% margin (AI inference cost ~$30-40/mo/location).

Moats.title: Three compounding advantages.
Moats.moat1Desc: Joey is the largest nail chain operator in NYC — 50 locations — and an equipment supplier to 100+ salons. She's their vendor. Zero CAC for the first wave.
Moats.moat2Desc: More stores → better data → smarter AI → more revenue → more stores. A competitor can copy features, but not 50 stores × 365 days of operational corrections.
Moats.moat3Desc: Started from a blank page in 2024. Every data model, API, and sync channel was built to support AI agents. No legacy to protect, no customer base to break.
Moats.calloutText: We don't claim others can't build AI. We move faster because we have no legacy to protect and a live 35-store testbed to validate every feature.

Team.title: Builder Meets Operator

Team.member2Bio: Founder of QQ Nails, NYC's largest nail chain. 18 years running 50 locations. Equipment supplier to 100+ salons. Domain expert + launch partner.
Team.member3Bio: Senior technical leader. AI/ML + infrastructure. Our first key hire to scale the AI agent layer and lead engineering.
